description: DIMOSIM is CSTB’s district modeller and simulator for transient building and energy-system analysis. It combines geometric building models, solar shading, thermal and electrical systems, and automatically or manually defined heating networks. The provider is CSTB. Coverage: The provider describes scales from a building to a district or city. GeoJSON and BDTOPO can support model construction; periods and resolution depend on the project. Access: The provider describes functions and example outputs on its public page. Software distribution and execution were not tested. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The provider’s speed and flexibility claims were not independently checked. Exact licensing, deployment and model restrictions require provider confirmation. For simulation it supports district-energy feasibility, network design and operational comparisons. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
